records.label: Second family (hHb1 Glu403Lys)
quotes: In the second family, we identified in affected individuals a lysine substitution of the corresponding glutamic acid residue, Glu 403, in the type II hair keratin hHb1, suggesting that this site represents a mutational hotspot in these highly related type II hair keratins.

records.label: Families and single case with hHb6 Glu410Lys
records.segregation: present in affected members of one family
quotes: In the present study, we have investigated two further unrelated monilethrix families as well as a single case. Affected members of one family and the single patient exhibited the prevalent hHb6 Glu 410 Lys mutation.

Here we report a novel mutation in a French monilethrix family, which again consists of a lysine substitution of another highly conserved glutamic acid residue, Glu402 (Glu106 of the 2B subdomain), in the EIATYRRLLEGEE motif of hHb1.

notes.statement: Winter et al. (1998) noted that previously reported monilethrix mutations in the type II hair cortex keratins hHb6 and hHb1 were restricted to Glu413 (Glu117 of the 2B subdomain) of the helix termination motif, and identified a novel lysine substitution of another highly conserved residue, Glu402 (Glu106 of 2B), in hHb1 in a French family.
quotes: Up until now, pathogenic mutations in the type II hair cortex keratins hHb6 and hHb1 were restricted to a highly conserved glutamic acid residue Glu413 (Glu117 of the 2B subdomains) in the EIATYRRLLEGEE helix termination motif of the two keratins.

Here we report a novel mutation in a French monilethrix family, which again consists of a lysine substitution of another highly conserved glutamic acid residue, Glu402 (Glu106 of the 2B subdomain), in the EIATYRRLLEGEE motif of hHb1.

notes.statement: Winter et al. (1998) found that family members carrying the hHb1 Glu402Lys mutation showed a particularly variable phenotype, ranging from dystrophic alopecia with follicular keratosis to moniliform hair detectable only by electron microscopy, to an adult with no clinical or ultrastructural signs despite a clear history of the disease.
quotes: Family members bearing the hHb1 Glu402Lys mutation exhibit a particularly variable disease phenotype.

notes.statement: Winter et al. (1997) found that the hHb1 Glu403Lys mutation affects the residue that corresponds to Glu410 in hHb6, which is in the helix termination motif. They suggested that this site is a mutational hotspot in these closely related type II hair keratins.
quotes: a lysine substitution of the corresponding glutamic acid residue, Glu 403, in the type II hair keratin hHb1, suggesting that this site represents a mutational hotspot in these highly related type II hair keratins

notes.statement: Winter et al. (1997) noted that hHb1 and hHb6 are largely coexpressed in the cortical trichocytes of the hair shaft. They concluded that monilethrix is a disease of the hair cortex.
quotes: Both hHb1 and hHb6 are largely coexpressed in cortical trichocytes of the hair shaft. This indicates that monilethrix is a disease of the hair cortex.
